response:
The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Cause of the Issue
In [`CoreOperationCompare.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/jxpath/ri/compiler/CoreOperationCompare.java), both `InitialContext` and `SelfContext` operands were being converted into single node pointers using `((EvalContext) l).getSingleNodePointer()`. For a multi-valued variable evaluated via an `InitialContext`, converting it to a single `NodePointer` collapsed the collection into an array object instead of preserving it as an iterable context (`Iterator`). This prevented multi-valued variables from being iterated during equality comparison against candidate elements.

### Solution
Updated [`CoreOperationCompare.equal`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_d_fix/src/java/org/apache/commons/jxpath/ri/compiler/CoreOperationCompare.java#L57-L71) so that `InitialContext` instances are reset (`((EvalContext) l).reset()`) rather than reduced to single node pointers, while `SelfContext` instances continue to extract their single node pointer.

The patch has been generated and saved to [`enlightened_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jxpath_6_group_d_fix/enlightened_fix.patch). The Cucumber tests pass completely.
